activeAlert: ACTIVE CYCLONE ALERT: Red alert issued for coastal Odisha. Stay indoors.

before: Secure loose items outside your home.
Prepare an emergency kit with 3 days of food and water.
Keep mobile phones fully charged and pack power banks.
Identify the safest room in your house (usually windowless).
during: STAY AWAY from glass windows and doors.
DO NOT venture out during the eye of the storm.
Listen to battery-operated radios for official updates.
after: Wait for official 'All Clear' before leaving shelter.
Do not touch loose or dangling wires.
Drink only boiled or bottled water.
Check house structure carefully before re-entering.

during: DROP to your hands and knees.
